Name: Fae Gate
Author: Blakllyte
Description:
[b][size=4]|| About ||
[/size][/b]
Are your Barn and Coops getting crowded with modded farm animals? Do you wish for a more lore friendly way to house all these fantastical critters? The Fae Gate is your solution! The building can be bought from the wizard alongside the obelisks, junimo hut, and gold clock after unlocking his summoning book!

[size=4][b]|| Features ||
[/b][/size]
- A brand new magical building which can be built for 30,000 gold with 300 stone, 50 moss, and 1 fairy rose
- Can hold up to 20 animals*
- Comes with a custom incubator that lights up, currently not craftable
- You can enter the building by interacting under the arch to the left, and open the animal door by interacting under the arch to the right.
-[b][u]Animals will not appear in Marnie's shop until after you have unlocked the summoning book.[/u][/b]
- Configuration option that allows you to view the greyed out animals before unlocking the summoning book! If you are having issues obtaining animals on an existing save toggle this option with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Menu[/url] to remove the event condition.
-Compatible with 4 different recolor mods! (See below for details)

*Farm Animals currently not included. See below for mod recommendations.


[size=4][b]|| Installation ||
[/b][/size]
- Make sure you have Content Patcher Installed
- Download the file
- Unzip the file into your respective mod folder

[size=4][b]|| Updates ||

[/b][/size]Make sure to delete the old file before installing the new one, future updates will likely contain renamed files or additional files that may get buggy if you just paste it over the old one. If something [i]is[/i] bugged, delete the mod file and reinstall it.

[size=4][b]|| FAQ ||[/b][/size]

[i][b]"Why was X compatibility removed/why haven't you added X compatibility yet? :("[/b][/i][b]
[/b][i]There are a lot of reasons why i removed certain compatibilities or wont add them, be it because they are outdated, personal preference, or lore conflicts/balancing issues. Feel free to suggestion mods however do know that compatibility will never be guaranteed.
If there is a mod you wish to have compatibility for but hasn't been added officially, feel free to add it yourself for[b] personal use[/b],however please know if you do this i wont be able to provide support if my or the other mod breaks.[/i][b]
[i]
"Can i create a translation for this mod?"
[/i][/b][i]Yes!! Id love translations!! I wont stop you from posting them separately but for ease of access for others, i [b]would[/b] prefer to incorporate them natively within the mod[/i][i].[/i][i]If you are comfortable, feel free to share the translation files in the comments of this post as well![/i][b]

[i]"I cant find the animals in marnie's shop[/i]"
[/b][i]Animals supported by this mod wont be visible until after you unlock the wizard's summoning book, this is to prevent clutter and add a sense of surprise as you will have to complete the community center before unlocking the gate and any animals that go with it. If you are having issues unlocking the animals on a preexisting save, toggle "Animals are visible" in the config menu, this will remove the summoning book requirement to see the animals, [b]they will still not be purchasable until after you unlock the book however.[/b][/i]
[b]
[size=4]|| Known Issues ||
[/size][/b]
- Very minor visual glitch in the build menu, you may not even notice it honestly, attempts to fix havent worked.

-If are using the Jumishrooms and have one of Wildflour's foraging modules disabled (wildfood or faerie) then smapi may send an error message. This shouldn't affect your game.

- Fae Gate does not include any animals currently, if you have an issue with an animal, disable this mod and make sure its not an issue with another mod before reporting here.

[size=4][b]|| Compatibility ||[/b][/size]

As of launch, the Fae Gate is compatible with the mods below, i highly recommend downloading at least one of these to fill your building with!

[b]For future mod authors: feel free to add compatibility with this building or require it as a dependency if you wish![/b]
[i]
If any mod authors would like to be removed from compatibility with this mod for any reason please message me and i will have it removed asap.[/i]
